text:
Evan (Sales Eng): Starting thread for Northbeam POC scope — they want chat assist + nightly reconciliation + rule-based alert summaries. Need to nail endpoints, success metrics, security asks, and timeline.
Priya (Solutions): Outline of flows: 1) web chat agent (streaming), 2) daily embeddings for reconciliation (batch), 3) alert summarizer (near-real-time). Priority: chat > reconciliation > alerts.
Maya (AE): Customer target: reduce Tier1 handle time by 20% and produce daily ops summaries. Asked for pricing anchors (hosted vs reserved) by Thu.
Lina (Customer PM): We'll provide sample data: 200 anonymized chat threads, 1k transaction rows, and 50 historical alerts. Delivery targeted Wed.
Evan (Sales Eng): Proposed endpoints: `/v1/chat/stream` (stream), `/v1/embeddings/batch` (nightly), `/v1/summarize/alerts` (sync). Suggest SLOs to discuss.
Priya (Solutions): Suggested SLOs: chat p95 < 325ms, embeddings job complete by 03:30 UTC, alert summarize p95 < 500ms. Open to tuning after perf run.
Omar (Security): Security must-haves: SOC2 pack, EU data residency for two regions, customer-managed KMS or HSM, audit logs for 90 days, PII redaction guidance. Private control plane requested as a possibility.
Maya (AE): Usage estimate for costing: ~2M chat tokens/month, 30k embeddings/night, ~500k alert calls/month. I'll send anchor numbers by Tue EOD.
Evan (Sales Eng): Acceptance (minimal): - Chat: p95 < 325ms and <1% disconnects, - Reconciliation: summary F1 >= 0.75 on customer eval set, - Alerts: precision uplift >= 10% vs baseline, - Ops: nightly job success >= 99%.
Omar (Security): Redlines: no unencrypted persistent KV for PII, HSM requirement for production keys, clear retention/deletion controls. I'll draft questionnaire responses by Tue.
Priya (Solutions): I'll stand up a sandbox harness and example config: ```endpoint: /v1/chat/stream
model: redwood-2-small-q4
stream: true
batching: adaptive
max_tokens: 800```
ci-bot: Deploy started: sandbox/northbeam/poc at 1725012400 — job #1203
Lina (Customer PM): Ack, samples on Wed. Demo requested at end of week2.
Evan (Sales Eng): Blockers: Private control plane could add 2-3 weeks, HSM onboarding timeline unknown, EU capacity for nightly embeddings. Mitigation: propose dedicated EU-only tenancy as interim.
Maya (AE): Noted procurement risk — keep contingency in timeline.
